query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revenueAccounts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  code VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  accountType ENUM('RECEITA_BRUTA', 'DEDUCAO', 'OUTRAS_RECEITAS') NOT NULL,
  saleType ENUM('BALCAO', 'DELIVERY', 'A_PRAZO'),
  isDefault BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  isActive BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  displayOrder INT DEFAULT 0,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE INDEX revenue_code_idx (code),
  INDEX sale_type_idx (saleType),
  INDEX account_type_idx (accountType)
);
